Name: OBJECT_PARAM_ST
Description: Settings for map objects: durability, how they break and what they spawn when destroyed, burning, wind, rigid body contact and collision behaviour.

Fields.Name: HP
Fields.Description: Durability before the object is destroyed. -1: indestructible.

Fields.Name: Defence
Fields.Description: Attacks with attack power below this value deal no damage.

Fields.Name: External Texture ID
Fields.Description: External texture to use: mAA_????.tpf, where AA is the area number. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Material ID
Fields.Description: Material of the object, treated the same as a floor material. -1: the previous default behaviour.

Fields.Name: Destruction Animation ID Max
Fields.Description: Highest animation destruction ID; the IDs run from 0 to this value.

Fields.Name: Camera Collides
Fields.Description: If ON, the camera collides with the object.

Fields.Name: Broken by Player Collision
Fields.Description: If ON, the object breaks when the player touches it.

Fields.Name: Animated Destruction
Fields.Description: 0: physical destruction. 1: animated destruction.

Fields.Name: Hit by Penetrating Bullets
Fields.Description: If ON, penetrating bullets hit the object.

Fields.Name: Characters Collide
Fields.Description: If ON, characters collide with the object.

Fields.Name: Repels Attacks
Fields.Description: If ON, attacks that hit the object are repelled (weapon bounce).

Fields.Name: Disable Destruction on First Appearance
Fields.Description: If ON, the object can't be destroyed when it first appears.

Fields.Name: Is Ladder
Fields.Description: If ON, the object is a ladder.

Fields.Name: Pause Animation in Cutscenes
Fields.Description: If ON, the object's animation stops while a cutscene plays.

Fields.Name: Ignores Damage
Fields.Description: If ON, damage does not hit the object.

Fields.Name: Is Moving Object
Fields.Description: If ON, the object is a moving object.

Fields.Name: Is Rope Bridge
Fields.Description: If ON, the object is a rope (suspension) bridge.

Fields.Name: Rigid Body Knocked Back by Damage
Fields.Description: If ON, damage knocks the object's rigid body away.

Fields.Name: Broken by Characters Standing On It
Fields.Description: If ON, the object breaks when a character gets on it.

Fields.Name: Is Flammable
Fields.Description: If ON, the object can burn.

Fields.Name: Broken by Enemy Collision
Fields.Description: If ON, the object breaks when an enemy touches it.

Fields.Name: Default LOD Param ID
Fields.Description: Default LOD param used for this object.

Fields.Name: Destruction - SFX ID
Fields.Description: Particle effect played when the object is destroyed. -1: the default (810030).

Fields.Name: Destruction - Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the destruction particle effect is spawned at. -1: the placement position.

Fields.Name: Destruction - Bullet Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Behaviour param of the bullet spawned when the object is destroyed. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Destruction - Bullet Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the destruction bullet is spawned at. -1: the placement position.

Fields.Name: Fall Destruction Height
Fields.Description: Fall height at which the object breaks when dropped. In metres. 0: it doesn't break from falling.

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Type - Pre-Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind effect type (before destruction)

Fields.Name: Wind Effect Type - Post-Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind effect type (after destruction)

Fields.Name: Camera Avoidance Type
Fields.Description: What happens when the object comes between the camera and the player.

Fields.Name: Wind Coefficient - Pre-Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind coefficient (before destruction)

Fields.Name: Wind Coefficient - Post-Destruction
Fields.Description: Wind coefficient (after destruction)

Fields.Name: Destruction Stop time
Fields.Description: Time after destruction before the rigid bodies are forced to stop. 0: no forced stop.

Fields.Name: Burn Time
Fields.Description: How long the object burns, in seconds. 0: it keeps burning.

Fields.Name: Burn Destruction Rate
Fields.Description: Burn progress at which the object switches to its destroyed state.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX ID [0]
Fields.Description: Particle effect 0 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX ID [1]
Fields.Description: Particle effect 1 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX ID [2]
Fields.Description: Particle effect 2 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX ID [3]
Fields.Description: Particle effect 3 played while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn - Bullet Behavior ID [0]
Fields.Description: Behaviour param of bullet 0 spawned while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn - Bullet Behavior ID [1]
Fields.Description: Behaviour param of bullet 1 spawned while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn - Bullet Behavior ID [2]
Fields.Description: Behaviour param of bullet 2 spawned while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn - Bullet Behavior ID [3]
Fields.Description: Behaviour param of bullet 3 spawned while burning. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Burn - Bullet Interval
Fields.Description: Interval between the bullets spawned to spread fire. In frames.

Fields.Name: Navimesh Flag
Fields.Description: Navmesh flag set by the object.

Fields.Name: Collision Detection Type
Fields.Description: Collision detection type of the object.

Fields.Name: Burn - Bullet Generation Delay Time
Fields.Description: Delay before the fire-spreading bullets are spawned. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX Delay [0] (Minimum)
Fields.Description: Start of the delay range for burn particle effect 0; the delay is chosen at random between the start and end times. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX Delay [1] (Minimum)
Fields.Description: Start of the delay range for burn particle effect 1; the delay is chosen at random between the start and end times. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX Delay [2] (Minimum)
Fields.Description: Start of the delay range for burn particle effect 2; the delay is chosen at random between the start and end times. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX Delay [3] (Minimum)
Fields.Description: Start of the delay range for burn particle effect 3; the delay is chosen at random between the start and end times. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX Delay [0] (Maximum)
Fields.Description: End of the delay range for burn particle effect 0; the delay is chosen at random between the start and end times. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX Delay [1] (Maximum)
Fields.Description: End of the delay range for burn particle effect 1; the delay is chosen at random between the start and end times. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX Delay [2] (Maximum)
Fields.Description: End of the delay range for burn particle effect 2; the delay is chosen at random between the start and end times. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Burn - SFX Delay [3] (Maximum)
Fields.Description: End of the delay range for burn particle effect 3; the delay is chosen at random between the start and end times. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Destruction AI Sound ID
Fields.Description: AI sound emitted when the object is destroyed.

Fields.Name: Debris Fragments - Wait Time
Fields.Description: Time before the debris fragments start to be hidden. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Debris Fragments - Invisibility Time
Fields.Description: Time taken to hide the debris fragments. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Rigid Body Collision - Soft
Fields.Description: Collision point distance coefficient of the rigid body for soft contacts.

Fields.Name: Rigid Body Collision - Normal
Fields.Description: Collision point distance coefficient of the rigid body for normal contacts.

Fields.Name: Rigid Body Collision - Hard
Fields.Description: Collision point distance coefficient of the rigid body for hard contacts.

Fields.Name: Land Touch - SFX ID
Fields.Description: Particle effect played when the object touches the terrain. -1: chosen by the terrain material.

Fields.Name: Blocks Damage
Fields.Description: If ON, damage the object receives does not pass through to the other side.

Fields.Name: Is Tumbleweed
Fields.Description: If ON, the object is a tumbleweed.

Fields.Name: Paint Decal Target Size
Fields.Description: Size of the paint decal target texture. 0 to 4096, powers of 2 only.

Fields.Name: Dynamic Object Duration
Fields.Description: Time a dynamically spawned object lasts before it disappears. In seconds. 0: it never disappears.

Fields.Name: Cloth Update Distance from Camera
Fields.Description: Distance from the camera within which the object's cloth simulation is updated. In metres. 0: always updated.

Fields.Name: Player Touch - Sound ID
Fields.Description: Sound played when the local player touches the object. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Landing Destruction - SFX ID
Fields.Description: Material-dependent particle effect identifier played when the object first lands after being destroyed. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Waypoint Dummy Poly ID [0]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly used for waypoint 0.

Fields.Name: Waypoint Param ID [0]
Fields.Description: Waypoint param used for waypoint 0.

Fields.Name: Sound Bank ID
Fields.Description: Sound bank used by the object.

Fields.Name: Draw Param Reference ID
Fields.Description: Draw param referenced by the object.

Fields.Name: Tumbleweed Spawn Height Offset
Fields.Description: Height offset at which the tumbleweed appears. In metres.

Fields.Name: Draw Param Reference ID (Damage)
Fields.Description: Draw param referenced when the object is damaged.

Fields.Name: Destruction Sound ID
Fields.Description: Sound played when the object is destroyed.
